# Crowbar workflow configuration for third_party/aria-practices

# 1. Fetch Upstream
Upstream-URL: https://chromium.googlesource.com/external/github.com/w3c/aria-practices.git
Revision: 7b134ce6d19497cce8a67db4a9f59980baf853dc

# 2. Check for Upstream Releases
Update-Check: Use latest commit on 'main' branch

# 3. Transform Rules & Directory Structure
Patch-Directory: patches/

Transform Steps:
1. Create empty working directory workdir.
2. Copy specified upstream pattern files and license into workdir:
   - content/patterns/ -> workdir/content/patterns/
   - LICENSE.md -> workdir/LICENSE.md
3. Exclude upstream CI, tooling, node_modules, build configs, and test files (.github, .husky, .vscode, test/, scripts/).
4. Apply local patch files from patches/ directory in alphabetical order.
5. Copy post-transformation workdir content into third_party/aria-practices/src/.
